posthoc_diagnostic.finding: All six failures reached the unchanged trace-coverage guard; boundary gaps are consistent with clipping. No PNG decoder defect was observed.

limits: One exploratory cohort: 32 queries from 32 people, only four target events, and one generated programme; no general native-versus-tools advantage is established.
Direct restrictions were instructions, not an enforced sandbox. Exact model snapshots and complete internal tool traces were unavailable.
The arms shared image inputs and demonstrations but had unmatched reasoning and compute budgets.
Both full answer sets and the programme source were frozen before trusted gold scoring; delivery/runtime errors remain incorrect in all 32 denominators.
Conditional bootstrap intervals use the observed class mix; the direct interval includes the 50% balanced-accuracy baseline. No significance or benchmark-pass threshold was selected.
No human or established trained-model baseline was run. Pretraining exposure, amplitude calibration and physical display-delay correction remain unresolved.
The target is experimental event identity, not physiological P3 presence. The result does not qualify the complete 6400-case condition, paper reproduction or SOTA.
This public aggregate transcription and its narrative hash do not independently authenticate private inputs, predictions, scoring or model execution. No private case records are included.
